This erases your island, your gear and everything you built.

Keys WASD move · Space dodge: dash the way you hold, backstep when still, roll when sprinting (hold Space or Shift to sprint) · F jump · Q or middle mouse lock on · mouse to look · click to strike (keep clicking for a 3-hit combo) · Shift + click heavy blow · right mouse to block, just before a hit to parry · E use · C character · Tab bag · B build · R turn piece · 1–7 tools · M map · P or Esc pause (Esc first frees the mouse)
The game also saves on its own every 20 seconds and whenever you leave the page.

Controls

Click a slot, then press the key you want. Esc cancels, Backspace clears the slot.

Use the whole screen

This browser won't let the game take over the screen while it sits inside Claude's chat. Safari on iPhone is one of these.

Open Fjordborn on its own page instead. It fills the whole screen with no chat beside it. Save first: your progress should carry over because it's the same game in the same browser.

Open Fjordborn on its own page

For even more room in Safari, open the page menu in the address bar and choose Hide Toolbar, if your version of Safari offers it.

Fjordborn

Washed ashore on a wild northern isle with nothing but your hands. Gather, craft, raise a hall, and wake the giant that sleeps under the Gloamwood.

Keys
WASD move · Space dodge: dash the way you hold, backstep when still, roll when sprinting (hold Space or Shift to sprint) · F jump · Q or middle mouse lock on · mouse to look · click to strike (keep clicking for a 3-hit combo) · Shift + click heavy blow · right mouse to block, just before a hit to parry · E use · Tab bag · 1–7 tools · M map · P pause
Touch
Left stick moves, push it to the rim to run. Drag anywhere to look around. Hold Block to raise your shield. Tap Dodge to backstep, dash the way you push the stick, or roll while running.

Turn your phone sideways

Fjordborn plays in landscape, with the stick under your left thumb and the actions under your right.

Tap this if your phone's rotation lock is on. The game will rotate itself instead.
